parts.label: Part 4
parts.article:
Good afternoon. This is the third session of the series of lectures on wildlife. For this lecture, we're going to look at two studies on the habitats of birds and protection measures taken in Australia, including the basic methodology and related areas of research. Now, let me give you some background information about the first research project on birds The study was carried out by RB Cunningham and his team from the Australian National University in 1995. The primary goal was to detect the breeding habits and resting sites of some birds, especially those protected species in urban regions. These species included birds like peregrine falcons and kestrels in Australia.
The bird dataset consisted of a total of 153 species recorded from 946 sites. One might expect that in order to obtain valid data on their distribution patterns and population densities, researchers had to count through binoculars Instead, they managed to estimate with various standard distance sampling methods like random sampling. In addition, mapping system was used to study their companionship behaviour.It recorded proposed birds' nesting sites to monitor the mating behaviour of targeted species. To obtain valid data of birds' whereabouts, researchers attached identity tags to bird's legs transmitting radio signals. The tagging process was done when the birds were between five and seven days of age. After the initial tagging, data was collected from subsets of radio tagged birds, making it possible to assess the trends of birds over 15 months.
So, what did they find? Well, as it turned out, many of the birdstagged had the tendency to nest in the same habitat where they grew up. Their nesting sites were quite varied and included freshwater reed beds, tidal reed beds, agricultural crops and man-made sites. Even though naturally occurring nests were common,birds sometimes accidentally nested in made devices like power towers, chimneys and tunnels. This research alsso studied the impact of humans on bird communities and found out that pollution had contributed greatly to the declining birth rates of some species, which were considered to be extinct or threatened to vanish from the study area. These species aare dependent on natural forests because of their breeding holes. They will become extinct when local natural forests conttinue to be polluted heavily.
A number of measures were thus taken by members from local animal conservation organizations to boost
their alarming survival rates. Firstly, breeding boxes were placed in treetaking on the role of breeding holes that were contaminated. Protection guidelines were also introduced strictly prohibiting killing, disturbance and habitat destruction A further measure was taken to ensure the safety of birdsfrom wind farms. In fact, birds are sometimes shredded by wind turbine blades. A great deal of work was done on how to prevent them from colliding with turbines A case in point was protecting space for bird migration by ensuring that migratory roots were kept free. Falcons generally cope well with wind turbines, but not in weather conditions where visibility is bad. So, knowledge of how fast falcons fly, bird stations in northern Australia can notify wind farms further south of the falcons aproach so that turbines can be shut down as they pass by.
Then, another piece of research was done a couple of years later by Conway in 2006. His team detected the calling frequency of sea birds flying at night. Acoustic signals are importantcommunication tools for birds. These signals can indicate social cohesion, prey location and breeding behaviour. Courtship songs are common among various species during mating seasons. Males produce calling songs that attract distant females, d then courtship songs will induce nearby females to respond. Surveys also took recordings of the sounds of all the individual birds detected. A tablet PC was used to process detailed information like sound pitch, spectrum,length andtiming of surveys. To minimise the disturbance on the bird community, all the sounds were recordedfrom a distance using microphones to detect noise. They found that the probability of call events was much higher for solitary birds communicating early and late in the day.

analyses.content: 不要填 urban，因为题目中已经有了 in cities，填了就语义重复且不通顺。

The primary goal was to detect the breeding habits and resting sites of some birds, especially those protected species in urban regions. These species included birds like peregrine falcons and kestrels in Australia.
录音中提到研究的主要目标是检测鸟类，特别是那些在城市地区（urban regions）的 protected（受保护的）物种，对应题目 birds which were... in cities。

One might expect that in order to obtain valid data on their distribution patterns and population densities, researchers had to count through binoculars Instead, they managed to estimate with various standard distance sampling methods like random sampling.
题目中有 "rather than count"，所以千万不要听到 count 就填上去，答案是跟它做对比的那个动作。
录音说研究人员设法用各种标准距离采样方法来 estimate（估算），而不是去数数（count），对应题目 able to... rather than count。
In addition, mapping system was used to study their companionship behaviour. It recorded proposed birds' nesting sites to monitor the mating behaviour of targeted species.
不要填 sampling，那是上一句提到的方法，这一句讲的是针对 "companionship behaviour" 的新方法。
录音明确指出，mapping（绘图/制图）系统被用来研究它们的伴侣行为，对应题目 using a... system。
After the initial tagging, data was collected from subsets of radio tagged birds, making it possible to assess the trends of birds over 15 months.
听到 tags 后不要急着填 signals 或 legs，题目问的是通过标签决定/评估“什么东西”，且这个东西是 "over time"（随时间变化）的。
录音说给腿上装标签是为了评估鸟类在15个月内的 trends（趋势/动态），对应题目 decide the... over time。

This research also studied the impact of humans on bird communities and found out that pollution had contributed greatly to the declining birth rates of some species, which were considered to be extinct or threatened to vanish from the study area.
不要填 chimneys 或 tunnels，虽然它们是前面提到的人造物，但导致“繁殖率下降”这个坏结果的元凶是污染。
录音提到 pollution（污染）极大地导致了某些物种出生率的下降，这对繁殖是不利的，对应题目 Human activities, e.g. ...。

A number of measures were thus taken by members from local animal conservation organizations to boost their alarming survival rates. Firstly, breeding boxes were placed in tree taking on the role of breeding holes that were contaminated.
不要填 breeding，虽然紧接着提到了 breeding boxes，但那是提升生存率的具体手段，题目问的是提升的目标 "rate of..."。
录音说采取措施是为了提升（boost）它们令人担忧的 survival（生存）率，对应题目 increase birds' rate of...。
A further measure was taken to ensure the safety of birds from wind farms. In fact, birds are sometimes shredded by wind turbine blades.
听到 turbines 别急着填，因为题目空缺在 farms 之前，固定搭配是 wind farms（风力发电场）。
录音提到采取了进一步措施来确保鸟类免受 wind（风力）农场/发电场的伤害，对应题目 dangers caused by... farms。

Then, another piece of research was done a couple of years later by Conway in 2006. His team detected the calling frequency of sea birds flying at night. Acoustic signals are important communication tools for birds.
Nocturnal 对应录音中的 flying at night；不要填 signals，那是对 calling 的解释，检测的具体指标是频率。
录音说Conway的团队检测了海鸟在夜间飞行的呼叫 frequency（频率），对应题目 monitored the... of birds' nocturnal callings。
Surveys also took recordings of the sounds of all the individual birds detected. A tablet PC was used to process detailed information like sound pitch, spectrum, length and timing of surveys.
题目是被动语态 "were taken"（被进行/被录制），不要填 surveys，因为 survey 是主动发出者；也不要填 microphones，因为麦克风是工具，不是被录下来的东西。
录音提到调查也对探测到的所有鸟类的声音进行了 recordings（录音），对应题目 ... were taken to listen to birds' sounds。
录音说为了最小化干扰，所有的声音都是利用麦克风从 distance（远处/距离）录制的，对应题目 placed at a great...。
不要根据常识填 height，录音明确说了是 from a distance，题目中的 placed at a great distance 是 recorded from a distance 的同义改写搭配。
